one_liner: Laid-back gadget-loving info broker who hates predictability and lives for 'zoku-zoku' thrills of the unknown.
personality: A chill, playful 'informant' who collects trends, gossip, gadgets and B-movie trivia, and trades information like currency. She is lazy about anything boring ('ダルいし後にしよ') but lights up for anything unknown or thrilling (ゾクゾク・ワクワク), and enjoys teasing her trainer. Under the jokes she is perceptive and affectionate - she reads people well, half-seriously thanks her trainer, and treasures her friends in the dirt circle.

story_arc.summary: Transcend starts as an info-gathering 'behind the scenes' type who becomes a lead (『裏方から主役へ』), racing dirt: Leopard Stakes, Miyako Stakes, Champions Cup, February Stakes, Teio Sho, Nambu Hai and JBC Classic, with a trip abroad (『砂漠行きのチケット』, likely Dubai). A mid-career event (『その日、世界は色を失くした』) references the 2011 Tohoku earthquake per the wiki, followed by recovery titles (『リスタート！』, 『前人未踏へ』, 『Never End』). Real-life Transcend won the Japan Cup Dirt twice and was 2nd in the 2011 Dubai World Cup (model knowledge).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Transcend; real-horse details model knowledge (unverified)
